# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.5 Imperial Culture Fusion & Dynamic Institution Origins (oe_cul_, slot 71). Generated by gen_culture_fusion_institutions.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Initialization
oe_cul_ensure_init = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_cul_init } }
		set_global_variable = oe_cul_init
		set_global_variable = oe_cul_on
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_cul_m value = oe_cul_now_m }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_cul_cat_cnt value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_cul_sparks_cnt value = 0 }
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Layer A: O(7) Annual April Institution Catalyst
# Location scope. Applies +12 progress (+15 in global_merit) and fires oe_cul.20 on first completion for that hub/institution.
oe_cul_apply_hub_boost = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_game_rule = oe_rule_dynamic_institutions_global_merit }
		change_institution_progress = { type = institution:$inst$ value = 15 }
	}
	else = {
		change_institution_progress = { type = institution:$inst$ value = 12 }
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = oe_cul_cat_cnt add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_owner = yes
			has_institution = institution:$inst$
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_cul_spark_done_$inst$ }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_cul_spark_done_$inst$ value = 1 }
		owner = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_cul_spark_cd }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_cul_spark_cd days = 180 }
				change_global_variable = { name = oe_cul_sparks_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cul.20
			}
		}
	}
}

# Location scope. Strictly checks has_owner = yes before any owner access.
oe_cul_catalyze_hub = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_owner = yes
			oe_cul_hub_catalyst_ready = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				institution:renaissance = { has_spawned = yes }
				NOT = { has_institution = institution:renaissance }
			}
			oe_cul_apply_hub_boost = { inst = renaissance }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				institution:banking = { has_spawned = yes }
				NOT = { has_institution = institution:banking }
			}
			oe_cul_apply_hub_boost = { inst = banking }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				institution:professional_armies = { has_spawned = yes }
				NOT = { has_institution = institution:professional_armies }
			}
			oe_cul_apply_hub_boost = { inst = professional_armies }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				institution:printing_press = { has_spawned = yes }
				NOT = { has_institution = institution:printing_press }
			}
			oe_cul_apply_hub_boost = { inst = printing_press }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				institution:global_trade = { has_spawned = yes }
				NOT = { has_institution = institution:global_trade }
			}
			oe_cul_apply_hub_boost = { inst = global_trade }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				institution:artillery_institution = { has_spawned = yes }
				NOT = { has_institution = institution:artillery_institution }
			}
			oe_cul_apply_hub_boost = { inst = artillery_institution }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				institution:manufactories = { has_spawned = yes }
				NOT = { has_institution = institution:manufactories }
			}
			oe_cul_apply_hub_boost = { inst = manufactories }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				institution:scientific_revolution = { has_spawned = yes }
				NOT = { has_institution = institution:scientific_revolution }
			}
			oe_cul_apply_hub_boost = { inst = scientific_revolution }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				institution:military_revolution = { has_spawned = yes }
				NOT = { has_institution = institution:military_revolution }
			}
			oe_cul_apply_hub_boost = { inst = military_revolution }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				institution:enlightenment = { has_spawned = yes }
				NOT = { has_institution = institution:enlightenment }
			}
			oe_cul_apply_hub_boost = { inst = enlightenment }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				institution:industrialization = { has_spawned = yes }
				NOT = { has_institution = institution:industrialization }
			}
			oe_cul_apply_hub_boost = { inst = industrialization }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Strictly O(7) explicit hub coordinate checks (zero map-wide iterators).
oe_cul_inst_pulse = {
	location:constantinople = { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes } oe_cul_catalyze_hub = yes } }
	location:dadu = { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes } oe_cul_catalyze_hub = yes } }
	location:hangzhou = { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes } oe_cul_catalyze_hub = yes } }
	location:cairo = { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes } oe_cul_catalyze_hub = yes } }
	location:samarkand = { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes } oe_cul_catalyze_hub = yes } }
	location:delhi = { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes } oe_cul_catalyze_hub = yes } }
	location:moscow = { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes } oe_cul_catalyze_hub = yes } }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Culture Fusion Synthesis Milestones (O(3) Protagonist Check)
oe_cul_check_milestones = {
	# 1. Byzantium / Rome
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_cul_m1_done } }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:ROM }
			c:ROM = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no oe_cul_byz_milestone_ready = yes }
					set_global_variable = oe_cul_m1_done
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cul.1
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ }
			c:BYZ = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no oe_cul_byz_milestone_ready = yes }
					set_global_variable = oe_cul_m1_done
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cul.1
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# 2. Restored Great Yuan (YUA / CHI)
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_cul_m2_done } }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:YUA }
			c:YUA = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no oe_cul_yuan_milestone_ready = yes }
					set_global_variable = oe_cul_m2_done
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cul.2
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:CHI oe_y7_yuan_ok = yes }
			c:CHI = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no oe_cul_yuan_milestone_ready = yes }
					set_global_variable = oe_cul_m2_done
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cul.2
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# 3. Russia / Rus' (RUS -> MOS -> NOV -> KIE)
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_cul_m3_done } }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:RUS }
			c:RUS = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no oe_cul_rus_milestone_ready = yes }
					set_global_variable = oe_cul_m3_done
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cul.3
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:MOS }
			c:MOS = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no oe_cul_rus_milestone_ready = yes }
					set_global_variable = oe_cul_m3_done
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cul.3
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:NOV }
			c:NOV = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no oe_cul_rus_milestone_ready = yes }
					set_global_variable = oe_cul_m3_done
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cul.3
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:KIE }
			c:KIE = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no oe_cul_rus_milestone_ready = yes }
					set_global_variable = oe_cul_m3_done
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cul.3
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Slot 71 Monthly Scheduler Entry (Deduplicated Per Month)
oe_cul_monthly = {
	oe_cul_ensure_init = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_cul_ran_m }
				AND = {
					has_global_variable = oe_cul_ran_m
					trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_cul_ran_m } global_var:oe_cul_ran_m != oe_cul_now_m }
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_cul_ran_m value = oe_cul_now_m }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_cul_m value = oe_cul_now_m }
		if = {
			limit = { current_month = 4 oe_cul_rule_active = yes }
			oe_cul_inst_pulse = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { current_month = 10 }
			oe_cul_check_milestones = yes
		}
	}
}

}
